sources.title: Train a LoRA Locally: Consistent AI Characters on Your Own GPU (2026)
sources.snippet: A LoRA fixes that: it is a small file that teaches the model one specific subject, so the same character comes back every time you call it. This guide explains what a LoRA actually is, how to train a LoRA locally on your own NVIDIA GPU, and why the photos you feed it matter far more than any training setting.
